shots.note: close: Haon still pressed against the pillar, breathing, glancing back over her shoulder; behind the pillar edge the giant lifts its axe
low angle up past the pillar: the giant raises the axe overhead and brings it down on the pillar
IMPACT, wide: the axe smashes the pillar, chips fly, the pillar topples and crashes flat (heavy shake); Haon bolts out into the open toward us
over Haon's shoulder across the fallen pillar: she catches her breath, raises her sword, the giant turns to her; she charges
low side, handheld: the giant's slice sweeps past, she leaps high over the fallen pillar, sword overhead, toward its legs
close low: she lands and slashes the giant's leg; it buckles and reels (hit, hit)
wide low: the giant turns away, drops to its knees and crashes face down (big shake); the axe flies from its hand and clatters onto the floor
silence, medium: Haon stands over the fallen giant, breathing hard; slowly she lowers her sword
insert, low at her feet: her fingers open and the sword drops and rings flat on the stone
she lifts her head to the far east: the altar glows at the end of the vault; she turns toward it
final: slow crane up and back over the fallen giant as Haon walks away east toward the altar glow, ember in her left hand, no sword
